method.startup: New process to visible enabled launcher input, observed every animation frame; same Playwright driver overhead; OS file caches not cleared. One warmup per build, then alternating order.
method.tools: Renderer-local clock from DOM click to visible JSON editor mutation, including first dynamic import; no locator polling/backoff or actionability delay.
method.resources: Actual clipboard polling explicitly started in test mode; 2s settling, 12 samples at 500ms, no forced GC. Separate clipboard guard is excluded from app process totals.
method.memory: OS RSS summed across app.getAppMetrics PIDs, includes shared-page double counting. Main private memory and renderer JS heap are supplementary.
